newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-KONSEL TO SIGN TWO-YEAR CONTRACT WITH AS ROMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KONSEL TO SIGN TWO-YEAR CONTRACT WITH AS ROMA.

text.p: Austria goalkeeper Michael Konsel of Rapid Vienna will sign a two-year contract with AS Roma after both clubs agreed on Tuesday on a transfer for nine million schillings ($729,000), the Austrian news agency APA said.
APA quoted Konsel's lawyer Skender Fani as saying: "Michael is basically already an AS Roma player. He will be signing the contract in Vienna which will then be faxed to Rome."
Konsel and Fani broke off negotiations with the Italian club on Monday after financial disagreements. Rapid originally wanted 10 million schillings for Konsel.
"The last few weeks were full of stress for me. Now I am relieved that everything worked out so well. I am really looking forward to my new assignment," Konsel, 35, said.
He will join his new team in Rome on Sunday and undergo medical examinations on Monday. ($ = 12.32 Austrian Schillings)
